name: gsc-seo-mcp
description: Secure, read-only Google Search Console tools for MCP clients.
long_description: Query allowlisted Google Search Console properties through four bounded, read-only tools. The server runs locally over stdio, requests only the webmasters.readonly scope, and fails closed unless an exact property allowlist is configured.

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List allowlisted Search Console properties for the authenticated account.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Query bounded Search Console performance rows for an allowlisted property.

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List Search Console sitemaps for an allowlisted property.

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: Inspect Google index status for a URL under an allowlisted property.

allowed_properties.title: Allowed Search Console properties
allowed_properties.description: Required JSON array of exact property identifiers, for example ["sc-domain:example.com","https://www.example.com/"].
